lead.t: Leading causes: obstetric haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders (pre-eclampsia and eclampsia), sepsis, unsafe abortion, obstructed labour and indirect causes (malaria, HIV, anaemia).
lead.s: Safe Motherhood Initiative, Birth Preparedness and Complication Readiness
